_comment: Release Shuttle (S1). Gated by balance s1_enabled. Unlock: petition phase 4 done. parts_need is preset-scaled; part_cost is per release part; countdown/siege numbers in ticks.
notice_text: The Metropolis moves the launch window closer. Every day you wait, the planet and the jailers get angrier.
